proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness is a property that inheres in agents (or collections of agents) — it characterizes the degree or mode of relational linkage among agents. As a measurable, inhering property of a bearer, Quality (BFO_0000019) is the most defensible BFO type. It is not a process (nothing unfolds), not a role (it is not externally grounded by social recognition), and not a disposition (there is no latent causal power strictly at stake). It is best read as a structural-relational quality inhering in an agent or a system of agents.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is a kind of Quality: it inheres in one or more agents and describes their relational state of connectedness.

open_questions: Is 'agent connectedness' a property of a single agent (how connected that agent is) or a property of a collective/network of agents (the degree to which they are mutually connected)? This affects whether the bearer is an individual or a group/institution.

Is 'connectedness' here intended as a social/institutional relation (suggesting Role or a relational quality), a psychological state (suggesting PsychologicalLegalManifestation), or a structural network property (suggesting it could be modeled as a subclass of RelationalCoherence, which already exists as a Quality)?
Should AgentConnectedness be treated as a subclass of the existing working:RelationalCoherence (BFO_0000019), since both describe relational/structural qualities of systems?
Is 'agent' here a legal agent, a human person, an institution, or a generic rational actor? This matters for constraining the domain of the 'inheres in' relation.
proposal.rationale_summary: The utterance asks to classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity, without specifying a context. The most defensible BFO typing is Quality (BFO_0000019): agent connectedness is a property that inheres in one or more agents, characterizing their relational linkage. It is not a Process (no temporal unfolding is asserted), not a Role (not externally grounded by social convention in the primary sense), and not a Disposition (no latent causal power is the core meaning). A possible alternative is Disposition (BFO_0000016) if connectedness is understood as a capacity or tendency to interact, but Quality is preferred absent further context. The existing class RelationalCoherence (BFO_0000019) is related but distinct enough that a new class is warranted; open questions are raised to allow the user to refine the typing before commitment.
